learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn good daily habits to keep our body clean, fit, and always smiling!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We must brush our teeth every morning and night to keep them sparkling. Taking a warm bath and wearing clean clothes keeps tiny bad germs far away from us!
Playing fun outdoor games, running in the park, and doing simple daily exercises make our bones and muscles very strong and active.
After a long day of playing and learning, our busy body gets tired. A good night of deep sleep helps us wake up fresh and ready for a new day!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Daily Routine Chart!
fun_activity.instructions: Make a colorful chart of your day! Draw a bright toothbrush for the morning, a smiling sun for playtime, and a sleeping moon for bedtime.

quick_recap: ⭐ Keeping our beautiful body clean helps us stay safe from sickness.
⭐ Playing outside and exercising makes our muscles and bones strong.
⭐ Sleeping on time gives our active brain the deep rest it needs.
